headline: Samsung's 100 Trillion Won Shareholder Return Deemed Stingy? Market Gives a Failing Grade with 9% Share Price Plunge - Finance
summary: Samsung Electronics announced a shareholder return plan of up to 110 trillion won, a record for a South Korean company. Its shares closed down 8.7% at 257,000 won on Monday, with affiliates also declining.
why: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest company and a global leader in memory chips and smartphones, so its payout policy and share price influence the KOSPI and global chip sentiment.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Shares fell nearly 9% on Monday after the shareholder return plan was announced.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Samsung shares fell nearly 9% to 257,000 won despite the record 110 trillion won return plan, which the market treated as underwhelming relative to the scale of the payout.
